name: @webship.co/workspace-database
description: The database family's shared base for Webship Workspace plugins: the DatabaseEngine contract, the readers that say which engine and version a project uses (DDEV, the runtime layer's x-webship block, a compose file of the project's own, SQLite files), and the DATABASE row menu (a console in a screen, export and import, tables and sizes, a web admin) every engine plugin registers through registerDatabase(api, engine).
